data.name: Aayah
data.gender_notes: Aayah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aayah refers to a sign, a token, or a verse in Arabic. In the Quran, it is used to describe a revelation from Allah. The name Aayah carries the meaning “Sign, token, verse” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aayah usually hope their child will grow to embody sign, token, verse and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder from Allah, a verse from the Quran.
data.etymology: Aayah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sign, token, verse.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aayah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
